task_specification.objective: Complete the release shell and semantic presentation, then extend the preserved authoritative foundation into a five-wave upgrade-and-Bellkeeper run without regressing combat, pause, pooling, retry isolation, or the intact cemetery.

diagnosis.root_cause: The verified survival foundation was not extended into release presentation or lifecycle: UI still uses minimal routes and fallback text drawing, Warden presentation chooses arbitrary clips plus procedural deformation, audio is one synthesized cue, and the run remains a single endless encounter without transactional upgrades, five-wave progression, boss, or victory.

stop_conditions: Stop if native_godot_project or host_godot_boot regresses.
Do not replace or alter authored package children; repair through product-owned bindings, directors, and additive anchors.
Reject assets without verified provenance, import integrity, and representative runtime suitability; do not substitute generic tones, primitives, or unrelated clips.
Do not expand into deferred camera, cemetery, or ordinary-enemy presentation work.
If no semantically valid Warden clip exists, seek a compatible intact supplemental source; never restore arbitrary fallback selection or procedural squash, bounce, or spin.

strategy.rationale: Use three bounded families: shell/HUD closure, semantic animation/audio repair, and the independently required authoritative complete-run increment. Preserve verified state ownership and make all five selected issues directly retestable.

code: Validate Godot import and scripts; retain clean boot/runtime logs through shell, combat, draft, boss, result, and three retries.
Verify no active fallback-font draw, generated sine construction, or arbitrary animation fallback remains.
Test wave legality, caps, XP overflow, one-choice debounce, upgrade stacking, boss/victory exactly once, spawn shutdown, and reset isolation.
runtime: Tester exercises all Title/Pause/Settings/Credits actions with mouse, keyboard, and gamepad and verifies persistence and pause ownership.
Tester binds idle/move/dash/cast/hurt/death/victory frames to animation state and authoritative events, then verifies clean retry.
Tester auditions audio owners separately and mixed at density, checking buses, voice limits, masking, duplication, and leaks.

Tester plays failure and successful seven-to-ten-minute routes through five waves, drafts, elite, both boss phases, Result, Retry, and Title; preparation fixtures may only establish stable inspectable states.
visual: Capture Title, Settings, Credits, active HUD, Pause, draft, boss HUD, and both Results at 1920x1080 plus supported scale/window modes.
Capture representative Warden animation states, adding close-ups only for feet, orientation, prop contact, or clipping.
Capture Waves 1, 3, and 4 plus Bellkeeper entrance, phase transition, attack, defeat, and victory at dense gameplay framing.
Record final-wave frame-time evidence with three weapons, enemies, pickups, UI, animation, VFX, lights, audio, and boss active.

done_when: Title exposes Play, Settings, Credits & Notices, and Quit; Pause exposes Resume, Settings, Restart Run, Return to Title, and Quit, with visible mouse/keyboard/gamepad focus and clean return paths.

Settings persist across restart and expose master/music/effects volume, window mode, UI scale, screen shake, hit flash, damage numbers, danger contrast, and target bias; Credits accurately displays candidate provenance.
Every active shell/HUD label uses imported product typography, while authoritative snapshot bindings, center-safe layout, health integration, pause ownership, and UI input interception remain intact.
HUD truthfully shows health, experience, level, wave/run progress, weapon ranks, dash readiness, and contextual boss health at native, windowed, fullscreen, and supported UI scales.
